speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The lane is full of them, back from the other bank, the jokes still in them. I am not going over to learn the jokes.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Casement shut. The street in the play can be as loud as it likes. This one can wait till morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The talker is still talking. I don't know the how. Early to bed. First light.
